EPISODE_NARRATIVE: Several intense clusters of storms moved through eastern Iowa into Illinois. The morning cluster produced flash flooding. In the afternoon and evening, a cluster of intense thunderstorms moved through far eastern Iowa into west central and northwest Illinois the evening of June 25th, with torrential rainfall and wind damage along it's way.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: There was about a 100 foot long stretch of Herbert Hoover Highway on-ramp to Interstate 80 that had around 6 inches of water over it.   Rapid Creek, northeast of Iowa City near Wilson's Orchard reported out of it's banks and flooding over the farm's bridge over Rapid Creek.
